description: This nested donut chart represents deception levels across two conditions, labeled as "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)," featuring a total of six distinct segments distributed across two concentric rings. Two separate legends are provided on the right side of the chart to define the color-coded categories for each ring. The outer ring, corresponding to Ambiguity 1, consists of three slices: a dark red slice representing "Deceived" that accounts for 67.6%, a gold-yellow slice representing "Partially" at 23.5%, and a dark green slice representing "Not Deceived" at 8.8%. The inner ring, corresponding to Ambiguity 2, also contains three slices: a bright red slice for "Deceived" at 57.9%, a bright yellow slice for "Partially" at 31.6%, and a light green slice for "Not Deceived" at 10.5%. Bold percentage labels are positioned directly inside their respective segments. Visually, the segments in both rings appear to be ordered by descending size in a clockwise direction starting from the top right, and no individual slices are exploded or offset from the main rings.
